derived.builtWith: Remotion (source in /video). Three-shot sequence with linear cross-dissolves, a distinct camera move per shot, a travelling light sweep and a breathing vignette. 15s, 1600x900 @ 24fps.
derived.replaces: An earlier ffmpeg zoompan on a single still — the client called it "a shaking image, not a real video", which was accurate.
derived.loop: Seamless by construction: every animated value is a function of the circular distance from the frame to a fixed point, so all have period TOTAL. Measured seam 2.29/255 (encoder noise).
derived.note: No new licence. Three already-licensed Unsplash photographs, motion only. ATMOSPHERE ONLY — never captioned or implied to be a Florida Green project.

derived.builtWith: Chrome headless screenshot of a 1200x630 HTML card, rendered at 2x and downsampled with Lanczos. Type is the site's own: Archivo at wdth 84 for the name, Archivo at wdth 92-100 for the labels, on --fg-ground #fafaf8 with the --fg-brand-yellow #f7b858 chip.
derived.note: No new licence. Closes baseline finding F-07, which BEFORE.md had wrongly recorded as already fixed. ATMOSPHERE ONLY — the photograph is not captioned and nothing on the card implies it is a Florida Green Improvements project.
